description: This file defines the class dm_easy_mesh_list_t which manages collections of mesh networks, devices, radios, BSS, stations, SSIDs, operational classes, policies, and scan results for a Wi-Fi mesh system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting these entities, as well as iterators for traversing lists of network components.
